This prompt is used to implement C# coding tasks with a focus on understanding the current code, planning changes, and
implementing them iteratively with user approval. It is designed to work with the `csharp.agent`, which provides
detailed guidance on how to approach C# coding tasks in a structured way. The agent will help you break down the task,
understand the existing codebase, and implement changes while following best practices for C# and .NET development.
